item.title: Animation
item.description: My passion for 2DFX has always been there since I started studying animation. I’ve had the chance to work on a couple of projects in charge of the 2DFX. Shortfilms: As de Bastos, Rodeo, Calcetines, Elvia Films: Chica y Lobo (Hampa) I also enjoy developing my own animated projects mixing music with animation. 2DFX practice Twitch waiting screen Commision for a twitch channel, I was in charge of all aspects.

item.title: Background and layout
item.description: RODEO Shortfilm where participated as a BG artist, Layout and prop design artist. A story full of pink, glitter and many many explosions. Two girls with a mission to steal from a grumpy old man a precious golden pistol.

item.title: Illustration
item.description: A Wedding at the Prado Museum Personal project. An educational guide for teenagers. Two characters guide the visitor throughout the museum, the text includes fun facts about each of the paintings plus an activity to do at the end of the visit. Each side has a different theme for those who prefer "romantic paintings" or a bit more "dark and gore" themes. Other works

item.title: Props
item.description: Rodeo I was in charge of designing most of the hero props, posters and painting around the saloon. Hua Awakens I was in charge of designing the street where the main character lived. The movie is located in Lima, Peru. The street resembled the local “Chinatown” known for their Chifa, restaurants that serve chinese cousine adapted to the peruvian taste.

item.title: Sketchbook
item.description: I like to organise art meet-ups with people at museums. Here are some of my sketches from exhibitions and people watching.

item.title: Visual Development
item.description: Ratinca Visual Development Project inspired by the work of Thomas Scholes A city located in a mountain top. Inhabited by rat like people, and architecture inspired by the Incas. The climate is foggy and very humid, witch tropical vegetation. Güiro Visual exploration for a graduation shortfilm.
